thumbnails.title: Miniatures
thumbnails.dimensionsHelp: Configurez la taille et la qualité des miniatures générées automatiquement. Des valeurs plus élevées produisent des aperçus de meilleure qualité mais augmentent le stockage et les temps de chargement.
thumbnails.qualityHelp: 1-100, plus élevé = meilleure qualité mais fichiers plus volumineux
thumbnails.fitHelp: Comment les images sont redimensionnées pour s'adapter aux dimensions des miniatures. "Cover" recadre pour remplir, "Contain" s'adapte dans les limites.
thumbnails.regenerateHelp: Après avoir modifié les paramètres des miniatures, régénérez toutes les miniatures existantes pour appliquer la nouvelle configuration. Cela s'exécute en arrière-plan et peut prendre un certain temps pour les grandes galeries.
thumbnails.regenerateError: Échec du démarrage de la régénération des miniatures
thumbnails.lightboxHelp: La visionneuse affiche un JPEG d'environ 1920 px préservant les proportions (généralement 200–500 Ko) plutôt que l'original complet (souvent 5–12 Mo). Les originaux sont toujours servis lorsque les invités cliquent sur Télécharger. Les aperçus coûtent environ un fichier supplémentaire par photo sur le disque et sont stockés dans /previews.
thumbnails.lightboxToggle: Activer la génération anticipée des aperçus
thumbnails.lightboxToggleHelp: Désactivé par défaut : chaque aperçu est créé la première fois qu'un invité ouvre la photo. L'activer débloque le bouton ci-dessous, qui les crée tous à l'avance.
thumbnails.previewsRegenerateStarted: Régénération des aperçus de la visionneuse démarrée

thumbnails.loadError: Échec du chargement des paramètres des miniatures

Augmenter la taille ou la qualité améliore l'apparence des photos dans la grille de la galerie mais utilise plus de stockage et de bande passante. Après avoir modifié les paramètres, utilisez "Régénérer toutes les miniatures" pour mettre à jour les photos existantes.
thumbnails.fitRecommendation: Recommandation : utilisez "Intérieur" pour les dispositions mosaïque / mosaïque / justifiée (préserve le rapport d'aspect) ; "Couvrir" pour les tuiles de grille uniformes 1:1.

seo.blockAiCrawlersHelp: Empêcher les robots de formation IA d'accéder à votre contenu.
seo.blockSocialBots: Bloquer les bots de prévisualisation des réseaux sociaux
seo.blockSocialBotsHelp: Empêcher les aperçus de liens sur Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, etc.
seo.metaNoindexHelp: Indique aux moteurs de recherche de ne pas indexer les pages (niveau HTML, complète robots.txt).
seo.metaNofollowHelp: Indique aux moteurs de recherche de ne pas suivre les liens sur les pages.
seo.metaNoaiHelp: Signale que le contenu ne doit pas être utilisé pour la formation IA.

analytics.title: Analytique
analytics.umamiUrlHelp: L'URL de votre instance Umami (ex. : https://analytics.yourdomain.com)
analytics.websiteIdHelp: Votre ID de site web Umami (trouvé dans le tableau de bord Umami)
analytics.shareUrlHelp: URL de partage publique pour intégrer le tableau de bord complet (créé dans Umami)
analytics.umamiInfoText: Umami est une plateforme d'analytique open-source axée sur la confidentialité. Elle suit les vues de pages, les visiteurs uniques et les événements personnalisés sans utiliser de cookies.
analytics.backendAnalyticsText: Le système suit également des analytiques de base côté serveur pour la sécurité et la surveillance des performances.
analytics.deviceTypes: Types d'appareils à partir des agents utilisateurs
analytics.privacyText: Les adresses IP sont hachées pour la confidentialité. Aucune donnée personnelle n'est stockée. Les données analytiques sont conservées pendant 90 jours.
analytics.providerDescription: Choose Umami or Rybbit for public gallery analytics. FotoDesk forwards data only; arbitrary custom scripts are no longer supported.
analytics.providerNoneInfo: No external events forwarded. The admin dashboard still shows summary cards and the daily chart from FotoDesk's own access_logs; device breakdown uses a coarse user-agent heuristic.
analytics.customDisabledHelp: Your legacy custom snippet is disabled and is not sent to visitors. Choose Umami, Rybbit or None, then save to clear the old snippet.
analytics.proxiedNoticeText: FotoDesk forwards sanitized page views and gallery events without loading third-party code. The collector receives visitor IP and user agent, but no query strings, page titles, referrers, tokens or account identifiers. Production collectors must use HTTPS.
analytics.customOnlyCspWarningText: FotoDesk ships with a strict CSP (`script-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'`). Unlike the Umami and Rybbit options above, a pasted snippet is not proxied — add your tracker's domain to BOTH `script-src` (to load the script) and `connect-src` (for the events it sends) in your reverse-proxy or nginx CSP config, otherwise the browser silently blocks it.
analytics.rybbitUrlHelp: Your Rybbit instance URL — `https://app.rybbit.io` for the SaaS, or `https://rybbit.yourdomain.com` for self-hosted.
analytics.rybbitWebsiteIdHelp: Found in Rybbit → Sites → your site → Tracking script.
analytics.rybbitApiKeyHelp: Optional. Required only for the device-breakdown chart. Generate in Rybbit → Account → Settings → API Keys. Stored masked as •••••••• once saved.
analytics.customHeadHtmlHelp: Paste your tracker's `<head>` snippet (Plausible, Matomo, Pirsch, GA4, GoatCounter, Fathom, Cloudflare Web Analytics, …). Sanitised on save: only `<script>`, `<noscript>`, `<link rel="preconnect|dns-prefetch">` and `<meta>` tags survive, and event-handler attributes are stripped. The admin dashboard's device-breakdown chart falls back to a server-side user-agent heuristic in this mode — pick Umami or Rybbit if you want the tracker-side numbers.
analytics.umamiApiKeyHelp: Optional. Required only for the device-breakdown chart on the Analytics dashboard. Generate in Umami → Settings → Profile → API Keys. Stored masked as •••••••• once saved — leave the masked value to keep the existing key.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.subtitle: Notifications POST d'événements vers votre URL dès qu'un événement se produit — galerie publiée, photo téléversée, événement archivé, etc. Signé avec HMAC-SHA256 dans l'en-tête X-FotoDesk-Signature.
webhooks.piiNotice: Les payloads event.* incluent les informations de contact du client (nom, e-mail, téléphone) et le jeton de partage de la galerie si vous les avez stockés. Ne pointez les webhooks que vers des récepteurs de confiance — ils ont tout ce qui est nécessaire pour envoyer un message au client ou ouvrir la galerie.

webhooks.filterHelp: Dot-path → expected value. All keys must match (AND). Use an array for "any of".
webhooks.templateHelp: Replaces the default JSON envelope as the request body. ${dot.path} substitution from the payload only — no logic, no expressions.
webhooks.confirmDelete: Delete "{{name}}"? Pending deliveries are also removed.

features.intro: Activez ou désactivez les surfaces du produit. Les fonctionnalités activées apparaissent dans la navigation de gauche et deviennent disponibles pour votre équipe. Certaines fonctionnalités sont encore en version bêta — activez-les pour les essayer, désactivez-les pour les masquer.

reminderEmails.title: E-mails de rappel
reminderEmails.description: Rappels automatiques aux invités avant l'expiration de leur galerie et aux administrateurs concernant les téléversements en attente.

messaging.title: Messagerie
messaging.description: Threads dans l'application avec les invités, attachés à une galerie. L'e-mail est vraiment bien pour la plupart des équipes — ceci est pour les studios qui veulent tout au même endroit.

calendar.title: Calendrier
calendar.description: Voir tous les événements à venir et passés sur une vue mensuelle/hebdomadaire. Accepter éventuellement de nouvelles réservations de la part des clients.

quotes.title: Devis
quotes.description: Envoyer des devis détaillés aux clients. Ils peuvent accepter ou refuser via un lien public ; le paiement est suivi manuellement.

bills.title: Factures
bills.description: Générer une facture à partir d'un devis accepté. Marquer comme payé manuellement — aucune intégration de processeur de paiement.

analytics.title: Analytique
analytics.description: Utilisation du stockage, vues des galeries, nombre de téléchargements et statistiques par événement.

userManagement.title: Gestion des utilisateurs
userManagement.description: Prise en charge multi-administrateurs avec autorisations basées sur les rôles. Désactivez si vous êtes un studio mono-opérateur.
userManagement.warning: Les comptes utilisateurs existants restent valides ; l'interface d'administration pour les gérer sera masquée jusqu'à ce que vous réactiviez cette fonctionnalité.

studioThread.title: Fil photo
studioThread.noteLabel: Ajouter une note visible uniquement par le studio

customerPortal.title: Clients
customerPortal.description: Connexions clients persistantes. Les clients réguliers voient toutes leurs galeries assignées au même endroit — pas de mots de passe par événement. Les clients se connectent via /customer/login et vous les gérez sous Clients → Comptes.

clients.title: Clients
clients.description: Interrupteur principal pour la section Clients de la barre latérale. Désactivé masque la section et toutes les sous-fonctionnalités ci-dessous, quel que soit leur état individuel — réactivez pour restaurer selon ce que vous avez défini en dernier.

incomingMail.title: Incoming mail
incomingMail.description: Poll a dedicated mailbox (IMAP) every minute and drop invoice attachments into Accounting → Incoming invoices. Configure the mailbox under Settings → Email.

calendarBooking.title: Customer booking
calendarBooking.description: Let customers see free slots on a public calendar and book directly. Coming soon.

taxReport.title: Tax export
taxReport.description: Period-scoped revenue list with net + VAT breakdown grouped by VAT rate. Export as PDF (landscape, company letterhead) or CSV for your accountant. Cancelled invoices stay visible for a gap-free audit trail but are excluded from totals.
taxReport.requiresBills: Enable Bills first — the tax report reads from your invoices.
taxReport.requiresAccounting: Enable Accounting first — Tax export lives in the Accounting section.

accounting.title: Comptabilité
accounting.description: A dedicated Accounting area, separate from CRM. Turn this on, then enable the sub-features below (Tax export, Incoming invoices). VAT / tax treatment is guidance only — verify with your Treuhänder before relying on it.
accounting.requiredByBills: On automatically because Invoices is enabled — invoice VAT settings live in the Accounting section.

incomingInvoices.title: Incoming invoices
incomingInvoices.description: Capture received supplier invoices (upload or phone/tablet camera), categorize expenses, and re-bill costs to clients on the relevant event with a contract-driven markup.
incomingInvoices.requiresAccounting: Enable Accounting first — Incoming invoices live in the Accounting section.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.description: Internal expenses (mileage, per-diem, cash) booked to an event or the company, with optional proof. Separate from incoming supplier invoices.
expenses.requiresAccounting: Enable Accounting first — Expenses live in the Accounting section.

contracts.title: Contrats
contracts.description: Compose contracts from a library of reusable blocks (image rights, NDA, model release, cancellation, jurisdiction…) and have customers sign in-browser or upload a wet-signed PDF. Seeded block bodies are EXAMPLES ONLY — review with your lawyer before sending.

crmDevelopment.title: CRM developer tools
crmDevelopment.description: Internal helpers for verifying CRM flows (e.g. fire the admin payment-check email instantly, bypass throttles). Surfaces as a "Development" sub-tab under Clients. Strictly opt-in — fires real side effects, use against test data only.

hoursLogging.title: Hours logging
hoursLogging.description: Per-customer time tracking. Admin logs date + start/end times + optional rate override + note. Monthly-mode customers auto-accumulate hours into the running monthly draft; per-event customers see a "Create draft invoice" button that mints a standalone draft invoice with one line per entry. Independent of Bills — log hours even before turning the full billing surface on.

projects.title: Projets
projects.description: Admin-only grouping layer above events. Bundle several events under one project and open a 360° Project Overview cockpit — milestone timeline plus a dated feed of every email (with the actual sent preview + resend/cancel/retry actions), quote, contract, invoice, gallery and logged hour. Adds a "book to project" control when logging hours. Customers never see projects.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
whatsapp.description: Deliver the gallery-ready notification via WhatsApp Business API in addition to email. Requires a Meta Business Account, an approved message template, and a customer phone number on the event. Configure credentials under Settings → WhatsApp.

slideshow.title: Live Slideshow
slideshow.description: A separate fullscreen "Diashow" link per event for projectors at live events — auto-picks-up new uploads, with per-event-type presets and global watermark defaults under Settings → Slideshow.

transfers.title: PicTransfer
transfers.description: Send files to a client as a secure, token-protected download link, and request files from a client through an upload link of their own. Strictly opt-in.

workflows.title: Flux de travail
workflows.description: Build visual automations on a canvas — triggers, conditions, branches, loops and admin approval gates. Your reminder ladder and booking steps become editable flows. Strictly opt-in.

faces.title: People in galleries
faces.description: Group each gallery's photos by the people in them, so guests can find themselves in two taps and download just their own photos. Runs entirely on your own server in a separate, optional container — nothing is sent anywhere. Detected faces are personal data, so this stays off until you enable it per gallery too.
faces.lockedSingleContainer: Not available on the all-in-one image. Face detection needs a separate ML container and competes with image processing for the same CPU and memory, which would slow the whole install down.

documents.title: Customer documents
documents.description: Share documents with a customer in their portal and receive documents from them. Customer uploads stay unavailable until you mark them clean on the customer record. PDF by default; more file types, size and storage limits under Settings → CRM.

vat.defaultOutputCode: Default VAT code for new invoices
vat.defaultOutputCodeHint: New invoices and quotes start with this VAT code selected. Existing documents are unaffected.

profileFields.dayRateHint: Used by per-day quote lines when a customer has no own day rate. In {{currency}}, major units.

accounting.rebillAttachProof: Attach the supplier proof to re-billed invoices by default
accounting.rebillAttachProofHint: When a captured supplier invoice is re-billed or passed through, attach its stored PDF to the client-invoice email as a separate proof. This is the default — a per-customer override and a per-file choice in the Send dialog can change it each time.
accounting.rebillProofNameFormatHint: Filename for the attached proof PDF. Tokens: {INVOICE}, {SUPPLIER}, {YEAR}, {MONTH}, {SEQ} (or {SEQ:03d}). Leave blank for the default “Beleg-{INVOICE}”. When several proofs ride one invoice, an index is appended automatically. Keep a prefix like “Beleg-” so the proof isn’t named identically to the invoice PDF.

whatsapp.phoneNumberIdHint: From Meta Business → WhatsApp → API Setup. The numeric ID Meta assigns to the phone you registered.
whatsapp.wabaIdHint: WhatsApp Business Account ID. Reference only (the API call uses the Phone Number ID); helpful for auditing.
whatsapp.accessTokenHint: Stored masked as "********" on GET. Leave the masked value to keep the existing token; type a new one to replace it.

sso.title: Single Sign-On (OIDC)
sso.intro: Let admins sign in through your identity provider (Keycloak, Authentik, Pocket ID, or any OIDC-compliant IdP). Local email/password login stays available as a fallback.
sso.superAdminOnly: Only a super admin can change the identity provider (issuer URL and client ID). Everything else on this tab can be edited.
sso.redirectUri: Redirect URI (register this on your IdP client)
sso.secretHint: Stored encrypted; never shown again. Leave blank to keep the current one.
sso.autoprovisionHint: Create an admin account on first SSO login. Off: only existing/linked admins can sign in.
sso.enabledHint: Shows the SSO button on the admin login page. Requires issuer, client ID and secret.
sso.testHint: Test runs OIDC discovery against the saved configuration — save first.

roleMapping.title: Role mapping
roleMapping.intro: Assign FotoDesk roles from a role or group claim in the ID token. Roles are re-evaluated on every SSO login — the IdP becomes the source of truth.
roleMapping.enabledHint: Off: existing admins keep their role and new users get the default role above.
roleMapping.claimHint: Keycloak: realm_access.roles · Authentik: groups · Entra ID: roles or groups
roleMapping.noMappings: No mappings yet — without one, no login gets a role from the IdP.
roleMapping.idpValuePlaceholder: IdP role or group, e.g. fotodesk-admins
roleMapping.requireRole: Require a mapped role to sign in
roleMapping.requireRoleHint: Refuse SSO logins whose token maps to no role — only members of the mapped IdP groups get in. The last active Super Admin is never demoted by mapping.

policy.title: Login policy
policy.disableLocalLoginHint: The login page shows only the SSO button and the API refuses password logins. Only possible while SSO is enabled; turning SSO off restores password login automatically.
policy.breakGlassHint: Locked out because the IdP is down or misconfigured? Set the environment variable OIDC_BREAK_GLASS=true on the backend and restart — password login comes back immediately.
policy.logoutFromIdp: Also sign out of the identity provider
policy.logoutFromIdpHint: Logging out of FotoDesk also ends the IdP session (RP-initiated logout). Only applies to sessions that signed in via SSO; without this, logging out of FotoDesk leaves the IdP session alive and the next SSO click signs straight back in.
policy.postLogoutRedirectUri: Post-logout redirect URI (register this on your IdP client, e.g. Keycloak "Valid post logout redirect URIs")

downloads.title: Download resolutions
downloads.intro: The standard size is what every gallery hands out by default. Individual galleries can override this.
downloads.picker: Let guests choose a download size
downloads.pickerHint: Adds a size picker to bulk downloads. Custom sizes are prepared on demand and are never larger than the standard.
downloads.allowOriginalHint: Off by default: lowering the standard size normally means full-resolution files should not be handed out.
downloads.presetsHint: Sizes are an upper bound — the aspect ratio is kept and photos are never enlarged.

productUsagePrompt.title: Help shape FotoDesk?
productUsagePrompt.intro: Help shape FotoDesk with optional product usage reports. Review the pseudonymous data, who can see it and where it is sent before deciding.

productUsage.fields: usage.v6 reports contain an installation fingerprint, FotoDesk version, UTC report date and generation time, schema/signing metadata, controlled gallery layouts, 87 fixed capability signals (64 configured/used pairs and 23 configuration-only booleans), and two installation totals: stored galleries and photo records excluding videos. Drafts and archived galleries and their retained photo records are included. The catalog below defines every field. There are no action counts or visitor observations.
productUsage.catalogTitle: Full catalog: 87 capability signals and 2 inventory totals (usage.v6)
productUsage.catalogExplanation: Configured describes current technical availability or configuration. Built-in means available, not used. Used is one installation-wide yes/no bit since consent to the reporting schema; accepted jobs mean initiated, not necessarily completed. Configuration-only capabilities omit used. Inventory contains only current gallery/photo record totals, with no per-gallery breakdown. No actor, entity identifier, action time or frequency is stored in usage markers.
productUsage.configurationOnly: Configuration only — actual use is not collected.
productUsage.versionDisclosure: This consent covers usage.v6 / usage-consent.v6: the same 87 capabilities and two inventory totals as usage.v5. The one change: Outbound webhooks counts as used after any successful delivery (HTTP 2xx), including automatic event-triggered deliveries, not only after an explicit admin test/replay. It stays one installation-wide yes/no bit; no destinations, event types, payloads, timestamps or counts are collected. Observations begin only after accepted consent. Previous versions keep their meanings and scope until upgrade; queued packets stay unchanged and markers restart after confirmation.
productUsage.upgradeExplanation: Your existing participation keeps its current scope. Review the expanded catalog and the two inventory totals before deciding whether to upgrade. Declining does not end participation.
productUsage.upgradePending: The signed consent upgrade is pending confirmation. Only the previously accepted scope is collected. Retry when the collector is available, or disable participation to stop and delete.
productUsage.pendingBlocksActions: The v6 upgrade and the usage portal are unavailable until the pending report is retried or delivered — use "Retry / send if due" above.
productUsage.pendingBlocksPortal: The usage portal is unavailable until the pending report is retried or delivered — use "Retry / send if due" above.

productUsage.title: Product usage & feedback
productUsage.notice: Optional product usage reports show which features matter to the community. Reporting is off until you choose to participate.
productUsage.ignoreHint: If you ignore this, the notice won't appear again — you can still join from Settings → Product usage.
productUsage.failed: The operation could not be completed. Check the status and try again.
productUsage.purpose: Help prioritize FotoDesk features, fixes, and maintenance using coarse information about participating installations.
productUsage.consentTitle: Choose whether to share product usage
productUsage.excluded: No visitor activity, clickstreams, per-gallery or per-photo breakdowns, names, emails, domains, filenames, image contents, biometric results, financial values or configuration secrets are included in automatic reports.
productUsage.transport: Your FotoDesk backend keeps the signing key and sends signed usage reports to {{collector}} once per UTC day during admin use. Preview reports and download each unique accepted report exactly as first received; transport retries are deduplicated. Rejected attempts and separately submitted feedback are not part of this report export.
productUsage.oneWay: FotoDesk only sends. It never fetches anything from the collector, never asks it for instructions, and exposes no endpoint the collector could call — there is no scheduled job and no inbound route on this path. From a reply it reads only the acknowledgement for the packet it just sent, and checks every field of that acknowledgement against the packet before accepting it; anything else is discarded. A data export you request yourself is handed to you as a file and is never interpreted or executed. So this channel cannot deliver code, configuration or content into your installation — not even from a collector that has been taken over.
productUsage.visibility: Participating installations can inspect the shared dataset of latest feature combinations and inventory totals, including groups of one, and shared aggregate history. Maintainers can inspect and export all retained original reports and private feedback. This does not authorize publication of private feedback. The schema and source are public. Your fingerprint and data are pseudonymous, not anonymous. Keep your lookup hash private: it grants read-only access to your own reports and the participant dataset.
productUsage.deletion: Disabling immediately stops collection and requests deletion of reports, aggregate contributions, feedback, published items, votes and sessions. During an outage, only credentials needed to finish deletion remain and the UI shows deletion pending. After confirmation, the local hash and key are erased; rejoining creates a new identity. The collector retains a one-way revocation digest and short-lived identity-free abuse counters. FotoDesk keeps a downloadable local deletion receipt without the old hash, key or payloads.
productUsage.feedbackDisclosure: Feedback is separate from automatic reports and is sent only when you submit it. Each item is anonymous unless you include a name, and private to maintainers unless you explicitly permit publication. Public items require maintainer review. Marketing use of a testimonial requires separate permission.

productUsage.signingKeyUnreadable: The usage signing key cannot be read, which usually means USAGE_ENCRYPTION_KEY — or JWT_SECRET, which it falls back to — was changed. Reports cannot be sent and the deletion request cannot be signed either. Restore the original encryption material to finish deletion; retrying or disabling will not resolve it on its own.
productUsage.schemaNotAccepted: The collector rejected the packet outright, which means it does not accept this report version yet — usually a collector that has not been upgraded. Retrying will not change that. Nothing has been registered, so you can discard the participation and join again once the collector supports it.

field.dueDateOverrideOff: Auto from send date + payment term — tick to set manually

field.paymentTermHelp: Net days + Skonto for this invoice. Leave blank to inherit from the source quote or the global CRM defaults.
field.skontoDisabled: Disable Skonto for this invoice (suppresses the early-payment-discount block on the PDF and the "Paid with Skonto" buttons in the admin email / record-payment dialog).

bills.importHelp: Attach a PDF from a previous billing system. The customer sees this original document in their portal — fotodesk does not regenerate it.

send.title: Send invoice
send.proofIntro: This invoice re-bills captured supplier invoices. Choose which supplier proofs to attach to the email — the invoice PDF is always attached.

businessProfile.movedToAccounting: The VAT rate, VAT label and default hourly rate now live under Settings → Accounting.
businessProfile.title: Business profile
businessProfile.subtitle: Issuer block shown on every quote and invoice PDF.

businessHours.title: Business hours
businessHours.subtitle: Set opening hours per weekday — add a second block for a lunch break. Interpreted in the timezone above ({{tz}}).
businessHours.floorToggle: Hold scheduled emails until business hours
businessHours.floorToggleHelp: When on, an automated email scheduled outside the hours above is delivered at the next opening instead of at an odd hour. When off, scheduled emails send at their exact time.

field.pdfLogoUpload: PDF letterhead logo (PNG, JPEG, or SVG)
field.pdfLogoUploadHelp: Used on every quote and invoice PDF. SVG is accepted and rasterised to PNG automatically. When empty, the renderer falls back to the global Branding logo.
field.pdfFoldingMarks: Folding marks on PDF page edge
field.pdfShowLogoHelp: When off, the logo image is suppressed on every PDF even if a logo is uploaded.
field.pdfShowCompanyName: Show company name in PDF letterhead
field.pdfShowCompanyNameHelp: When off, the company-name line is suppressed (useful if the logo is a wordmark already containing the name).
field.pdfCompanyNameInline: Render company name inline with address
field.pdfCompanyNameInlineHelp: When on, the company name appears as a plain line directly above the street address (same size + weight). When off, it renders as a bold title under the logo.
field.pdfQuoteShowNetDays: Show net payment days on quote PDFs
field.pdfQuoteShowNetDaysHelp: When on, quote PDFs include the "X days from invoice date." line in the payment conditions block. Invoices always show this row regardless.
field.pdfQuoteShowSkonto: Show Skonto / early-payment discount on quote PDFs
field.pdfQuoteShowSkontoHelp: When on, quote PDFs include the Skonto offer and the "Amount with discount" line. Invoices always show these regardless.

foldingMarks.third: Thirds (105 + 210mm) — for DL / DIN long envelopes

qrDisclaimer.title: QR-bill / bank data — verify before going live
qrDisclaimer.body: FotoDesk is open source. We render the QR code and IBAN block from the values you typed — we don't validate them. Print a test invoice and scan it with your bank's app before sending real invoices. We are not responsible for any mistakes that come from sending an invoice with bad data on it.

businessProfile.logoConfirmClear: Remove the PDF logo? The renderer will fall back to the Branding logo if one is set.

emailSignature.title: Email signature
emailSignature.subtitle: Append your company details to the footer of every email this installation sends. Built from the address and contact fields above — nothing is duplicated.
emailSignature.toggleHelp: When off, emails keep the plain logo + company name footer. Applies to every automatic email — gallery notices, quotes, invoices, reminders — plus test sends and previews. Replies you write yourself in Messages are sent as typed and do not get the signature.
emailSignature.extraHelp: Registration number, disclaimer or any line with no field of its own. Plain text, up to 500 characters.
emailSignature.previewOff: Signature is off — emails show the logo and company name only.
emailSignature.previewEmpty: Signature is on but every field above is blank — nothing will be added to the footer.

crmSettings.title: CRM settings
crmSettings.subtitle: Fine-tune quote and invoice behaviour.
crmSettings.emptyState: No CRM features are currently enabled. Turn on Quotes, Invoices, or Contracts in Settings → Features to see the matching configuration here.

section.dashboardOverviewHint: Hide CRM overview tiles on the admin dashboard. All tiles render by default; uncheck to hide.
section.documentsHint: Documents exchanged with customers in their portal. Customer uploads stay unavailable to them until reviewed.

paymentDefaults.help: Pre-filled on every new quote and invoice. The editor still lets you pick a different combination per document.

installmentDefaults.help: Pre-fill the trigger for fresh rows in the Installments panel. Per-document edits override; existing documents keep their snapshotted plan.

lateFeeAgb.title: Late fees must be itemised in your terms (AGB)
lateFeeAgb.body: A contractual duty: phrases like “late fees apply” aren't enough. Your terms must state the concrete fee (e.g. “CHF 20 from the 2nd reminder”). Verify with your Treuhänder.

dunningMoved.title: Reminder schedule is now in Workflows
dunningMoved.body: When and how often overdue reminders go out is configured in the “Invoice dunning” workflow. The late-fee amounts below still apply.

crm_invoices_vat_note_text.label: VAT / free-text note on invoices
crm_invoices_vat_note_text.placeholder: e.g. Gemäß § 6 Abs. 1 Z 27 UStG 1994 wird keine Umsatzsteuer berechnet (Kleinunternehmer).
crm_invoices_vat_note_text.help: Printed directly under the MwSt. line on every invoice PDF. If the business isn't VAT-registered (Settings → Accounting), it replaces that line on invoices without VAT. Quotes never carry it — an offer is not the tax document. Leave empty to hide. Please confirm the exact wording with your tax advisor.

crm_invoices_qr_enabled.label: Render payment QR on invoice PDFs

crm_invoice_round_total.label: Reconcile sub-cent rounding to a clean total (adds a "Rundung" row when per-line rounding drifts from qty × rate)

crm_invoices_reminders_enabled.label: Send automatic reminders for overdue invoices

crm_invoices_late_fee_enabled.label: Add a late fee on every reminder after the first

crm_quotes_tos_required.label: Require customers to tick "I accept the Terms of Service" before accepting

crm_quotes_tos_text.label: Inline Terms text shown on the quote page
crm_quotes_tos_text.placeholder: Paste the contract terms here. Plain text. Leave empty to only show the checkbox + URL.

crm_contracts_require_drawn_signature.label: Require drawn signature (typed name alone is not enough)

crm_contracts_allow_pdf_upload.label: Allow customer to upload a wet-signed PDF

crm_contracts_store_ip.label: Store signer's IP address (recommended — corroborating evidence in civil disputes)
crm_contracts_store_ip.help: When off, the customer's and admin's IP at signing time is NOT recorded into the contract row or the public sign-page audit confirmation. Per GDPR data-minimisation principle some operators prefer this — but IP is corroborating identity evidence if the contract is challenged, so we recommend keeping it on.

crm_contracts_notify_each_signature.label: Email me every time a signer signs (not only when everyone has)

crm_contracts_reminder_days.label: Signing reminders (days after the last link)
crm_contracts_reminder_days.help: Comma-separated, e.g. 3,7: a reminder with a new link 3 days after the last one, then 7 days after that. Leave empty for no reminders.

crm_contracts_alert_unknown_tokens_per_i.label: Alert after unknown signing links per client and hour

crm_contracts_alert_otp_failures_per_con.label: Alert after wrong codes per contract and hour

crm_contracts_legal_notice.placeholder: Empty: the standard notice (simple electronic signature, not for contracts that need written form).
crm_contracts_legal_notice.help: Frozen into each contract when it is sent, shown on the signing page and printed on the signing certificate. Changing it affects only contracts sent afterwards.

crm_contracts_alert_unknown_tokens_per_h.label: Alert after unknown signing links per hour, all visitors together

customer_documents_notify_on_share.label: Email the customer when a document is shared with them (default for the checkbox on the customer record)

customer_documents_forbidden_alert_thres.label: Alert after attempts on other customers' documents (per hour)

customer_documents_request_reminder_days.label: Remind about requested documents after (days, comma-separated; empty = off)

customer_documents_allowed_formats.label: File types customers can upload
customer_documents_allowed_formats.help: Every file is checked by its content. PDF is the only type on by default. The check of Word, Excel and OpenDocument files is best-effort: it refuses macros, embedded objects and the known ways of linking to outside content (including web links), but it does not detect every active-content mechanism these formats have. Turn them on only for customers you trust, and open such files with care. CSV files are passed on as they are: a formula in one runs when someone opens it in a spreadsheet.

crm_invoices_service_date_mode.label: Service date equal to the invoice date
crm_invoices_service_date_mode.note: State it in words ("same as invoice date")
crm_invoices_service_date_mode.help: Only applies when the service date falls on the invoice date; a service period always prints. Tax law in CH/LI and DE/AT wants the time of supply on the invoice, so leaving the row out is a decision to confirm with your tax advisor.

dealLineage.title: Related documents
dealLineage.empty: No other documents share this deal yet. New invoices, contracts, or installments will show up here once created.

detail.confirmConvertEvent: Convert this contract into an event + scheduled invoices?
detail.confirmConvertInvoice: Convert this contract into invoice(s) only? No gallery / event will be created.

largeSend.title: Large send — check your sending reputation first
largeSend.body: Mailing {{count}} people at once from a domain that usually sends only transactional email is what makes spam filters take notice. Providers may throttle, junk or block the whole batch, and a bad run damages delivery of your gallery emails too.
largeSend.advice: Confirm SPF, DKIM and DMARC are set up for your sending domain, send yourself a test first, and consider splitting a first campaign across several smaller sends.
largeSend.duration: At {{rate}}/minute this takes about {{minutes}} minutes. The send queue is shared, so while it runs other email — gallery invitations, password resets — can be delayed behind it.
